QuestInfo.name: Mai's Final Training
QuestInfo.0: Mai's training is a simple monster-hunt. But it is very useful in getting used to hunting. Let's get Mai's training, which might be the last training in Maple Island.
QuestInfo.1: Mai told me to hunt stronger monsters. Of course it is important to know your own strength, but to develop your strength, you need to try to hunt stronger monsters.\n\n#o1210102# #r#a10171# #k
QuestInfo.2: After getting Mai's traning, I became much stronger. I think I am going to leave Maple Island to get a job I like. Let's go to South Ferry and head to Victoria Island.

0.0: You're a quick study! Good! Let's move on. It's important to know your limits, but if you don't challenge stronger monsters, you won't grow stronger. So? You up to the challenge?
0.1: You think that looks weak? That just shows how inexperienced you are! That monster can beat novices like you with one hit! What are you laughing for?

yes.0: This time, you'll be taking on #o1210102#, which you WON'T find just by wandering around. You'll have to walk around everywhere, go into every portal, and defeat the orange-colored mushrooms. I want you to defeat #r1#k of them!! Remember, they are considered the most powerful monsters on this island ... oh, and Biggs is collecting something about the #o1210102#'s. If you haven't done Biggs a favor already, then ... I suggest you help him out while training. \n\n#o1210102# #r#a10171# #k

1.0: So you've taken care of all the Orange Mushrooms? Weren't they hard to find? It would have been difficult to find them just by walking around. You could enter every portal or the door; that would have helped quite a bit. Let's see how strong you have become...

yes.0: Great job! I can see that you're now strong enough to hold your own against any monster here. You'll have to start making job decisions once you reach level 8. Well then, until we meet again ....

mob.0: I don't think you've killed enough. Press Q and check on the quest.
